title: Inference-time Scaling of Diffusion Models through Classical Search
authors_zh: Xiangcheng Zhang、Haowei Lin、Jianzhu Ma、Yitao Liang（Helixon）；Haotian Ye、James Zou（斯坦福大学）；Yilun Du（哈佛大学）
paper_type_zh: 扩散模型测试时搜索研究
best_for_zh: 研究非自回归测试时扩展的读者。
one_line: Classical search improves diffusion inference through verifier-guided Langevin local search and BFS/DFS global exploration.
该工作以朗之万局部搜索和 BFS/DFS 全局搜索扩展扩散模型推理。
why: It makes local refinement and global branching explicit compute-allocation choices.
inclusion_reason: It allocates test-time compute through explicit local and global search over diffusion trajectories.

title: Problem
问题
html: Diffusion models usually generate a sample by following one predetermined denoising schedule. Even when an intermediate trajectory looks promising, inference cannot readily direct extra computation to it; conversely, weak trajectories still consume the same number of steps. This limits task-directed control in planning, control, and compositional image generation. The paper draws its decision boundary around test-time control rather than retraining the diffusion model: given a base generative distribution, a finite inference budget, and a score-producing verifier, how can the generative space be searched principledly so that valuable candidates are retained or refined while unpromising ones are abandoned? Its relevance is that it turns “spending more steps” into an inspectable search and budget-allocation problem.

扩散模型通常沿预设去噪日程一次性生成样本：即使某个中间轨迹明显更有希望，推理过程也难以把额外算力集中给它；反之，低质量轨迹仍会消耗同样的步数。这限制了模型在规划、控制和组合图像生成中按任务目标调整输出的能力。论文关注的决策边界是测试时控制，而非重新训练扩散模型：在给定基础生成分布、有限推理预算和一个可评分的验证器时，怎样有原则地搜索生成空间，持续保留或细化高价值候选，并放弃不值得继续计算的候选。其相关性在于，它把“多算几步”转化为可检查的搜索与预算分配问题。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The central idea is to view diffusion sampling as both local optimization and global mode exploration. Locally, the method reweights the base diffusion distribution with verifier scores and uses annealed Langevin MCMC to refine the current sample toward higher-scoring regions. Globally, it treats candidates at different noise levels as nodes in a search tree: breadth-first search retains and expands promising branches, whereas depth-first search backtracks and re-noises a trajectory when its score is insufficient. The verifier can be a collision cost, Q-function, classifier, or visual-attribute detector. The essential point is not merely selecting a final sample, but allowing intermediate scores to decide where the next unit of compute goes, balancing quality, coverage, and cost.

核心思路是把扩散采样同时看作局部优化和全局模式探索。局部层面，方法以验证器分数重加权基础扩散分布，并用退火 Langevin MCMC 沿着更高分区域细化当前样本；全局层面，它把不同噪声层级的候选视为搜索树节点，用广度优先搜索保留并扩展有前景的分支，或用深度优先搜索在分数不足时回溯并重新加噪。验证器可以是碰撞代价、Q 函数、分类器或视觉属性检测器。关键不在于单纯挑选最终样本，而在于让中间评分决定下一单位算力投向何处，从而兼顾质量、覆盖和成本。

title: Method
方法
html: The method first defines a target distribution combining the base diffusion distribution with verifier scores, so that high-scoring outputs are preferred during sampling. For an individual candidate, annealed Langevin MCMC adds local updates determined by the gradient of this target distribution at each denoising stage, alternating with ordinary denoising. For multiple candidates, BFS allocates child nodes in proportion to scores of intermediate predicted samples, or gradually removes weak particles through pruning; DFS follows one path and returns to a higher-noise level for renewed exploration when its score falls below a threshold. Experiments use maze-collision loss, a pretrained Q-function in offline reinforcement learning, and class or attribute verifiers for images, comparing against naive sampling and Best-of-N under matched budgets.

方法先定义由基础扩散分布与验证器分数共同构成的目标分布，使高分输出在采样时更受偏好。对单个候选，退火 Langevin MCMC 在各去噪阶段加入由该目标分布梯度决定的局部更新，再与常规去噪交替执行。对多个候选，BFS 根据中间预测样本的分数按比例分配子节点，或通过剪枝逐步移除弱粒子；DFS 则跟踪单一路径，在分数低于阈值时回退到更高噪声层并重新探索。实验分别使用迷宫碰撞损失、离线强化学习中的预训练 Q 函数，以及图像任务中的类别或属性验证器，并在预算匹配条件下与朴素采样和 Best-of-N 比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Evidence comes from three settings with different properties. In long-horizon maze planning, local refinement reduces trajectory-wall collisions, and adding global search improves success as the inference budget grows; the project page reports over 80% success in difficult settings with global search. In offline reinforcement learning, the method guides an action distribution with a pretrained Q-function and obtains performance comparable to methods that require additional training on D4RL locomotion tasks. Image experiments use visual verifiers for object counts, attribute binding, relations, and class conditions, showing search to be more efficient than Best-of-N, which only draws parallel samples and selects the highest score. These gains nevertheless depend on the verifier providing reliable rankings at intermediate states, so output quality and total wall-clock cost must be reported together.

证据来自三个性质不同的场景。长时程迷宫规划中，局部细化能降低轨迹碰墙，加入全局搜索后，复杂迷宫的成功率随推理预算增加而提升；项目页展示的全局搜索结果在困难设置中达到八成以上。离线强化学习中，方法以预训练 Q 函数引导动作分布，在 D4RL 运动控制任务上取得与需要额外训练的方法相近的表现。图像实验则用视觉验证器检查对象计数、属性绑定、关系和类别条件，显示搜索比只并行抽取后挑最高分的 Best-of-N 更有效率。不过这些收益均依赖验证器能在中间状态提供足够可靠的排序信号，因而质量和总耗时必须一起报告。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Compared with treating diffusion inference as a fixed sampling chain or applying Best-of-N reranking only at the end, the paper offers a unified classical-search interpretation: local Langevin updates climb within a current mode, while tree search allocates branches and backtracking across a multimodal generative space. It also places BFS resampling, BFS pruning, and threshold-triggered DFS backtracking in one framework, making the number of samples, local iterations, branches, and backtracking depth auditable test-time compute decisions. The novelty is not a new diffusion training objective or a new general verifier; it is the use of search structure to connect existing diffusion models with task-verification signals, tested across planning, control, and image tasks.

相较于把扩散推理视为固定采样链、或只在末端执行 Best-of-N 重排序的做法，论文提出了一个统一的经典搜索解释：局部 Langevin 更新负责在当前模式内爬升，树搜索负责在多峰生成空间中分配分支与回溯。它还把 BFS 重采样、BFS 剪枝和阈值触发的 DFS 回退置于同一框架，使“样本数、局部迭代数、分支数和回退深度”都成为可审计的测试时计算决策。新意不在于提出新的扩散训练目标或新的通用验证器，而在于用搜索结构连接已有扩散模型和任务验证信号，并跨规划、控制与图像任务检验这种连接。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method is constrained by several conditions. First, if a verifier favors superficial features, becomes unreliable off distribution, or can be exploited by candidates, search may amplify the wrong objective more efficiently rather than improve real task quality. Second, Langevin step size, reweighting strength, BFS particle budget, DFS threshold, and backtracking distance all affect stability and cost; the paper itself notes that search-based inference needs more hyperparameter tuning than naive sampling. Third, local gradient refinement and tree search add verifier calls, memory use, and wall-clock time, so superiority cannot be claimed from final scores alone. Finally, the subject is continuous diffusion generation: it provides evidence for non-autoregressive test-time scaling, but does not directly establish benefits for language-model chain-of-thought reasoning or tool-using agents.

该方法的效果受几个条件约束。首先，验证器若偏向表面特征、在分布外状态失真，或可被候选利用，搜索会更高效地放大错误目标，而非提高真实任务质量。其次，Langevin 步长、重加权强度、BFS 粒子预算、DFS 阈值与回退幅度都会影响稳定性和成本，论文也指出搜索式推理比朴素采样需要更多超参数调节。再次，局部梯度细化和树搜索会增加验证调用、内存占用与墙钟时间，不能只按最终分数宣称更优。最后，研究对象是连续扩散生成；它提供了非自回归测试时扩展的证据，但不能直接推出对语言模型链式推理或工具智能体同样有效。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This paper is a useful design reference for non-autoregressive test-time scaling. If a diffusion policy, trajectory generator, or image model already has scoreable signals such as collision, return, class, attribute, or constraint satisfaction, the framework can compare three compute choices: how much local correction to apply to one candidate, how many candidates to branch across, and when to abandon and backtrack. Reuse should explicitly record verifier provenance, information visible at each step, particle count, local-update count, thresholds, backtracking rules, and total budget; it should also report task score, verifier score, success rate, sample diversity, and real latency. It is especially useful for studying how verification signals alter generation trajectories, rather than treating search as unexplained extra sampling.

这篇论文适合用作非自回归测试时扩展的设计参照。若已有扩散策略、轨迹生成器或图像模型，并能提供碰撞、回报、类别、属性或约束满足等可评分信号，可以据此比较三类算力配置：在单一候选上做多少局部修正、在多少候选间展开分支、何时放弃并回溯。复用时应明确记录验证器来源、每一步可见信息、粒子数、局部更新次数、阈值、回退规则和总预算；同时报告任务分数、验证器分数、成功率、样本多样性及实际延迟。它尤其适合研究“验证信号如何改变生成轨迹”，而非把搜索当作不可解释的额外采样。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Five points are worth retaining. First, the goal is not to replace the diffusion model, but to add verifier-guided local and global search around a fixed model. Second, local search changes the update direction at every denoising stage through annealed Langevin MCMC; global search uses BFS resource reallocation or DFS backtracking to avoid remaining in one mode. Third, Best-of-N is a necessary baseline because it also spends repeated sampling budget but does not use intermediate states. Fourth, maze, D4RL, and image results demonstrate cross-task applicability of the framework, not reliability of the verifier itself. Fifth, before reproducing results, check whether budgets are matched, verifiers are calibrated, search success coincides with reduced diversity, and any added gain exceeds the actual latency.

阅读时可抓住五点。第一，方法的目标不是替换扩散模型，而是在固定模型外增加由验证器引导的局部和全局搜索。第二，局部搜索通过退火 Langevin MCMC 改变每个去噪阶段的更新方向；全局搜索通过 BFS 的资源重分配或 DFS 的回溯避免只困在单一模式。第三，Best-of-N 是必要基线，因为它同样花费多次采样预算，但不利用中间状态。第四，迷宫、D4RL 和图像结果证明框架具有跨任务适用性，却不等于验证器本身可靠。第五，复现实验前应先核对预算是否匹配、验证器是否校准、搜索成功率是否伴随多样性下降，以及额外收益是否超过实际延迟。
